pr.title: Text the sign-up link to already-eligible opt-ins
pr.body: When the opted-in number is already in the client's eligible base, enqueue one sign-up SMS job for it. The member table has a unique constraint on (client_id, mobile_number) — the PR body claim; the migration is the fact.
pr.author: dev

migrations.content:
CREATE TABLE valkyrie.eligible_member (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    client_id uuid NOT NULL,
    employee_id text,
    mobile_number text,
    full_name text,
    CONSTRAINT uq_eligible_member_client_id_mobile_number
        UNIQUE (client_id, mobile_number),
    PRIMARY KEY (id)
);
